questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.misconception: reverses the direction of the reasoning the passage sets out
treats "Both after the verb" as if it followed from the evidence
substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes

options.text: Ne before, pas after the conjugated verb

questions.explanation: Ne precedes and pas follows the conjugated verb. The key is D, "Ne before, pas after the conjugated verb". Option A ("Pas before, ne after") is wrong: reverses the direction of the reasoning the passage sets out. Option B ("Both after the verb") is wrong: treats "Both after the verb" as if it followed from the evidence. Option C ("Both before the verb") is wrong: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes.
questions.hint: Ne before, pas after the verb.
